verdict.rationale: Pulley documents standard option templates, equity plan capacity, board/investor e-signature collection, and 409A valuation services, which together cover pieces of an equity-issuance workflow, but no single evidence item describes an integrated end-to-end flow linking board approval to a 409A-derived strike price at grant time. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified workflow connecting board approval, 409A strike price application, and option issuance in one step; independent/hands-on confirmation of this flow working as described.
